title.zh: 精讲 · 半周长线长 HPWL

lines.zh: 这一讲用几分钟，把半周长线长 HPWL 从定义讲到代码。
lines.en: In a few minutes: half-perimeter wirelength, HPWL, from the definition to the code.
lines.speak_zh: 这一讲用几分钟，把半周长线长，也就是 H P W L，从定义讲到代码。
lines.speak_en: In a few minutes: half-perimeter wirelength, or H P W L, from the definition to the code.

lines.zh: 布局决定每个单元放在哪里；单元之间由线网相连。
lines.en: Placement decides where each cell goes, and nets connect the cells.

lines.zh: 真实导线要等到布线阶段才画出来，代价很高。
lines.en: Real wires are only drawn at routing time, and that is expensive.

lines.zh: 所以布局时先用一个又快、又能比较的估计：HPWL。
lines.en: So during placement we use a fast, comparable estimate instead: HPWL.
lines.speak_zh: 所以布局时，先用一个又快、又能比较的估计：H P W L。
lines.speak_en: So during placement we use a fast, comparable estimate instead: H P W L.

lines.zh: 图里的细虚线只说明谁和谁相连，不是导线。
lines.en: The thin dashed lines only show who connects to whom; they are not wires.

lines.zh: 先看两个引脚：P 在 (1, 1)，Q 在 (5, 4)。横向差 4，纵向差 3。
lines.en: Start with two pins: P at (1, 1), Q at (5, 4). Four across, three up.
lines.speak_zh: 先看两个引脚。P 在 1、1，Q 在 5、4。横向差 4，纵向差 3。
lines.speak_en: Start with two pins. P at one, one. Q at five, four. Four across, three up.

lines.zh: HPWL = 4 + 3 = 7，就是曼哈顿距离，不是直线距离 5。
lines.en: HPWL = 4 + 3 = 7: the Manhattan distance, not the straight-line 5.
lines.speak_zh: H P W L 等于 4 加 3，等于 7。这就是曼哈顿距离，不是直线距离 5。
lines.speak_en: H P W L is four plus three, seven. That is the Manhattan distance, not the straight-line five.

lines.zh: 芯片导线大多横平竖直；这条 L 形只是许多等长路径之一。
lines.en: Chip wires mostly run horizontally and vertically; this L is one of many equal-length paths.
lines.speak_zh: 芯片导线大多横平竖直。这条 L 形，只是许多等长路径之一。

lines.zh: 四个引脚的线网 N1：逐个读取引脚，记下最小和最大的 x、y。
lines.en: A four-pin net, N1: read the pins one by one and keep the smallest and largest x and y.
lines.speak_zh: 四个引脚的线网 N 1。逐个读取引脚，记下最小和最大的 x 和 y。
lines.speak_en: A four-pin net, N one. Read the pins one by one, and keep the smallest and largest x and y.

lines.zh: P 给出初值；Q 刷新最大 x 和最大 y；R 再刷新最大 y；S 在内部，什么也不改。
lines.en: P sets the start; Q raises max x and max y; R raises max y again; S is inside and changes nothing.
lines.speak_zh: P 给出初值。Q 刷新最大 x 和最大 y。R 再刷新最大 y。S 在内部，什么也不改。
lines.speak_en: P sets the start. Q raises max x and max y. R raises max y again. S is inside, and changes nothing.

lines.en: Width 7 − 1 = 6, height 6 − 1 = 5, so HPWL = 11.
lines.speak_zh: 宽是 7 减 1，等于 6；高是 6 减 1，等于 5；H P W L 等于 11。
lines.speak_en: Width: seven minus one, six. Height: six minus one, five. So H P W L is eleven.

lines.zh: 把极值引脚 Q 向右拖：最大 x 从 7 变成 9，HPWL 从 11 变成 13。
lines.en: Drag the extreme pin Q to the right: max x goes from 7 to 9, and HPWL from 11 to 13.
lines.speak_zh: 把极值引脚 Q 向右拖。最大 x 从 7 变成 9，H P W L 从 11 变成 13。
lines.speak_en: Drag the extreme pin Q to the right. Max x goes from seven to nine, and H P W L from eleven to thirteen.

lines.zh: 再把 Q 往下拉：越过 y = 1 时，最小 y 换成 Q，HPWL 变成 14。
lines.en: Now pull Q down: once it passes y = 1, Q becomes the minimum y and HPWL becomes 14.
lines.speak_zh: 再把 Q 往下拉。越过 y 等于 1 时，最小 y 换成 Q，H P W L 变成 14。
lines.speak_en: Now pull Q down. Once it passes y equals one, Q becomes the minimum y, and H P W L becomes fourteen.

lines.zh: 每一帧的数字都由同一组坐标当场重算。
lines.en: Every frame recomputes the numbers from the same coordinates.

lines.zh: 再移动内部引脚 S：只要留在绿色区域里，N1 一直是 14。
lines.en: Now move the interior pin S: while it stays in the green region, N1 stays at 14.
lines.speak_zh: 再移动内部引脚 S。只要留在绿色区域里，N 1 一直是 14。
lines.speak_en: Now move the interior pin S. While it stays in the green region, N one stays at fourteen.

lines.zh: 但 S 也在线网 N2 上：N2 从 4 变成 2，总和从 18 变成 16。
lines.en: But S is also on net N2: N2 drops from 4 to 2, and the total from 18 to 16.
lines.speak_zh: 但 S 也在线网 N 2 上。N 2 从 4 变成 2，总和从 18 变成 16。
lines.speak_en: But S is also on net N two. N two drops from four to two, and the total from eighteen to sixteen.

lines.zh: 选中的线网没变，不等于总线长没变。
lines.en: An unchanged net does not mean an unchanged total.

lines.zh: 老师的例子有六个单元、六个线网；ABCD 是一个四引脚线网，只算一个包围盒。
lines.en: The teacher's example has six cells and six nets; ABCD is one four-pin net with a single box.
lines.speak_zh: 老师的例子有六个单元、六个线网。A B C D 是一个四引脚线网，只算一个包围盒。
lines.speak_en: The teacher's example has six cells and six nets. A B C D is one four-pin net, with a single box.

lines.zh: 逐网计算：AB、CD、AC、BD 各为 8，ABCD 为 16，EF 为 4。
lines.en: Net by net: AB, CD, AC and BD are 8 each, ABCD is 16, and EF is 4.
lines.speak_zh: 逐网计算：A B、C D、A C、B D 各为 8；A B C D 为 16；E F 为 4。
lines.speak_en: Net by net: A B, C D, A C and B D are eight each. A B C D is sixteen. E F is four.

lines.speak_zh: 总和是 8 乘 4，加 16，加 4，等于 52。
lines.speak_en: The total: eight times four, plus sixteen, plus four, is fifty-two.

lines.zh: 写成代码，第一步先检查输入：未知引脚、空线网、坐标缺失，都要报错。
lines.en: In code, validate first: unknown pins, empty nets and missing coordinates are errors.

lines.zh: 然后对每个线网求最小、最大的 x 和 y，宽加高，累加到总和。
lines.en: Then, for each net, take the min and max of x and y, and add width plus height to the total.

lines.zh: 一次遍历全部引脚，代价与引脚总数成正比。
lines.en: One pass over all pins; the cost grows linearly with the pin count.

lines.zh: 记住：HPWL 等于宽加高，是包围盒周长的一半；多引脚线网只算一个盒子。
lines.en: Remember: HPWL is width plus height, half the box perimeter, and a multi-pin net counts one box.
lines.speak_zh: 记住：H P W L 等于宽加高，是包围盒周长的一半；多引脚线网只算一个盒子。
lines.speak_en: Remember: H P W L is width plus height, half the box perimeter, and a multi-pin net counts one box.

lines.zh: 移动极值引脚会改变盒子；内部移动不改变这个线网，但可能改变别的线网。
lines.en: Moving an extreme pin changes the box; an interior move leaves that net alone but may change others.

lines.zh: 进阶片讲它的边界：比如为什么 HPWL 为 0 也不是好布局。
lines.en: The advanced film covers its limits, such as why an HPWL of zero is not a good placement.
lines.speak_zh: 进阶片讲它的边界，比如为什么 H P W L 为 0，也不是好布局。
lines.speak_en: The advanced film covers its limits, such as why an H P W L of zero is not a good placement.
